native_lifecycle.guards: Serial Simulation without external reset or competing writer. Positive production-module proofs and real counterexamples for intentionally false assertions supplement execution; zero arcs remain in raw denominators.
native_lifecycle.raw_report_export: gcov -b -c -j after real lifecycle corpus, retain -fdump-tree-cfg-lineno and per-plant scopes. No generated-model/system-library aggregate or damaged hard-limit counter export substitutes for source evidence.

rtl_source_flow.scope: Original Verilator5.020 source-flow union, every raw source/elaboration identity retained; only hierarchy omitted. Aggregated public-port cases, not per-plant completeness or global signal coverage.
rtl_source_flow.counter_accounting: Baseline historical counts retained. Later cumulative snapshots contribute maximum observed raw value solely to establish positive execution, not an execution-frequency total. uint32 counter wrapping cannot erase earlier observations.

software_verification.python_coverage: Exact published source CI must have100percent statement and branch reports; actual Codecov commit endpoint checked before archive publication.
software_verification.hardware_boundary: No physical UIO/PAC1934 acquisition, privileged FIFO admission, CDC/synthesis timing or board measurement qualification is inferred.
